name: qkd_pv_rs_hd_f

pin_regs.reason: KV-RTRUNK: a result-trunk station is ONE register stage pin to pin (inject: a / y -> 2:1 -> flop -> b; header: trunk words -> AND / 2:1 -> flop -> beat word); its flop is the pin register of every pin; pv_trunk_gen counts exactly 1 core cycle per station (RS_D), so a flow-inserted pin register would change the static beat schedule; AD3-KV-RSHD 10-18: the native successor keeps each replicated select inside its own output half (8 loads, no AND)

job.purpose: AD3-KV-RSHD 10-18: PV result-trunk HEADER with HALF-LOCAL selects (lower half muxes take part-0 V copies a0v, upper half part-1 copies a1v, 8 loads each, no AND / no cross-half net; epoch banks er <- a0t, o_epoch <- a1t), 190.08 x 43.2 um; successor of qkd_pv_rs_hd_r (CLOSED, native capture FAIL S+R 259.9 on 94 select pins)

structural_change: AD3-KV-RSHD 10-18: native successor of qkd_pv_rs_hd_r (CLOSED TT +258.9 / FF +23.6, native capture FAIL S+R 259.9 > 190 on 94 pins: each V copy va[k] = a0v[k] & a1v[k] joined two part pins and drove 16 muxes in BOTH halves; a0t & a1t drove 32 epoch flops). Half-local selects: lower half <- part-0 copies, upper half <- part-1 copies (8 loads, no AND); er <- a0t, o_epoch <- a1t. Exact because pv_trunk_gen drives both T0 parts V / T from the same signals through stations clocked together (pair bench lockstep). Same ports, same one-stage schedule (pv_trunk_gen --rs-hd f).
